title: Check connection state
summary: WebSockets: Check connection state. Read the state before open and compare.
introduction: readyState reports the current state. Inside open, it equals WebSocket.OPEN.
learningObjectives: Read the state before open and compare

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Check connection state

blocks.text: The callback runs only after open. Comparing readyState with OPEN therefore prints true.
Read the state before open and compare.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The connection can close later, so readiness is not a permanent promise.
